briefdescription.para: This macro helps to implement some common rope functions, not depending on a specific rope, only once, in a single object file.
Find a rope node which contains the substring at p_offset, adjusting tree size with adjust_size and saving the path in path.
Route to successor or predecessor node of the node in path.

detaileddescription.para: It's either the rightmost leaf of the left child (previous node) or leftmost leaf of the right child.

briefdescription.para: Traverse left until the left subtree is NULL, save the path in iter->path.

simplesect.para: iter->path[iter->top] is not NULL and points to the last not-NULL node.
